notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we're excited to bring you the demo for Reason Unfound!

We really hope you enjoy it. We would love to hear your thoughts and feedback, which you can share with us in our [url=https://discord.gg/wcbmH4VVEp]Discord server[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021690/

[i]PS: The game works on Steam Deck! If you experience any issues, please turn off the VHS setting in the settings menu.[/i]
